findings.rule: Heat treatment specified in notes must not be contradicted by the title block.
findings.reasoning: The title block heat_treatment field is '---' (indicating none), but note N1 explicitly requires case hardening to 55–60 HRC with a 0.8–2 mm case depth. This contradiction will cause the part to be manufactured without the required heat treatment.
findings.correction: Update the title block heat_treatment field to reference N1 or state 'CASE HARDEN 55-60 HRC PER NOTE N1'.

findings.rule: Specified hardness must be achievable for the selected material and process.
findings.reasoning: Material 20MnCr5 is a low-carbon case-hardening steel; its core hardness after carburizing and quenching is typically 30–45 HRC. Note N1 specifies 'TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55 ~ 60 HRC' without clarifying that this applies only to the case surface, risking confusion or rejection if interpreted as bulk hardness.
findings.correction: Revise N1 to explicitly state 'SURFACE HARDNESS 55–60 HRC' and add a core hardness requirement appropriate for 20MnCr5 (e.g., 30–45 HRC).

findings.rule: Holes should not exceed a practical depth-to-diameter ratio for standard drilling.
findings.reasoning: Feature F4 defines a drilled hole of Ø5 mm (D14) that is 40 mm deep (D15), giving an 8:1 depth-to-diameter ratio. This exceeds the recommended 3:1 to 5:1 limit for standard twist drills, making it prone to drift, breakage, and poor surface finish without specialized deep-hole drilling.
findings.correction: Increase the hole diameter, reduce the depth, or specify a deep-hole drilling process such as gun drilling.

findings.rule: Functional diameters on mating or locating features require tolerances or fit classes.
findings.reasoning: The outer diameters (D1, D13 at Ø30) and inner bore diameters (D4, D12 at Ø20) have no tolerances assigned. As a 'TCP PIN SLEEVE', these are functional mating surfaces that will fall back to loose general machining tolerances (±0.5 mm per IS 2102 for sizes up to 30 mm), which is unacceptable for a sleeve fit.
findings.correction: Assign appropriate tolerances or ISO fit classes (e.g., h7, H7) to all functional outer and inner diameters.
